name: plan_place_on_colored_support
summary: Compose colored support geometry and TCP-preserving placement planning into IK-checked stacking stages for an already-held object.

generality.rationale: It supports different rigid held objects and support shapes, but inherits HSV support segmentation and assumes centered top-down stacking.
assumptions: The support is the largest component of a supported color and has a visible horizontal top.
The held object was grasped through its center and remains held top-down.
The held object's height is passed from measured geometry rather than guessed.
limitations: Does not distinguish touching same-color supports or reason about support stability beyond center placement.
Does not handle arbitrary semantic categories, side insertion, or continuous collision planning.
Requires post-release observation to verify the stack.

level.rationale: It orchestrates live RGB-D support geometry, target-height construction, live TCP orientation, profile constraints, and chained placement IK.

composition.strategy: Convert a perceived support top and measured held-object height into an explicit target center, then invoke the generic placement planner.

provenance.failure_gap: Qwen successfully stacked red and green after using the grasp combo, but guessed placement joints and failed to add blue.
evidence: iter_002 final state has red-green centers within 2.2 mm while blue remains separate; native_success=false
